spots.name: Gates of the Mountains Wilderness
spots.tip: Wildlife is most active in the first two hours after sunrise. Stay on trails, use your car as a blind on auto routes and give animals space.

spots.name: Cedar Hill
spots.tip: A notable summit. Check the road and trail first; first and last light on high ground is the reason to go, and it's often the subject from below. Summit 1,491 m (4,892 ft).

spots.name: Two Camps Vista
